resources.string: Backups stay on your device or wherever you send them. Chikku never uploads them.
A backup holds your home screen layout, folders, dock, widget placements, settings, app customizations and drawer groups.
To a folder, SD card or cloud storage app
Send with Drive, email or another app
Preview changes before anything is replaced
Widgets come back as placeholders; tap each one to add it again.
After reinstalling Chikku, some app shortcuts need to be added again from their app. Older Firefox website shortcuts may open as ordinary web pages instead of installed web apps.
Default settings and a fresh home screen

All settings return to their defaults, hidden apps and drawer groups are cleared, and the home screen starts with an empty page and the default dock. You can undo this afterwards, including after restarting Chikku.
Your current layout and settings will be replaced. You can undo the restore afterwards.

resources.string: Installed apps could not be checked; apps that are missing will keep their places as placeholders.
Some restored settings need something this phone doesn\'t have yet. They are kept and explained after the restore:
The backup could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
The backup could not be prepared for sharing.
The file could not be opened.
This file is too large to be a Chikku backup.
This file is damaged or isn\'t a backup. Your layout was not changed.
This file isn\'t a Chikku backup. Your layout was not changed.
This backup was made by a newer version of Chikku. Update Chikku to restore it. Your layout was not changed.
This backup is damaged and can\'t be restored. Your layout was not changed.
The restore failed and was rolled back. Your layout was not changed.
Recovery could not finish. Your saved recovery copy is kept, and further layout changes are blocked. Free up storage if needed, then retry loading the home screen.
The reset failed and was rolled back. Nothing was changed.
Restored your previous layout and settings.
Undo failed. Your current layout was kept.
No app is available to pick a file.
Google Discover is on, but the Google app isn\'t installed or is disabled on this phone. Swiping to the feed won\'t open anything until it is available.
Google Discover is on. Showing cards here needs the optional Chikku Discover bridge app, which isn\'t installed. Until then, swiping to the feed opens the Google app.
Google Discover is on, but the Chikku Discover bridge app isn\'t working (disabled, from another build, or restricted). Swiping to the feed opens the Google app until it is fixed.
The icon pack from the backup isn\'t installed. System icons are shown until you install it or pick another pack.
A messaging app you kept on contact results isn\'t installed here. Your choice is kept; it appears on contact results once the app is installed and has synced contacts.
The dock background image was chosen on another phone and can\'t be opened here. Pick it again to show it.
A private, offline home screen. A few quick choices get you started; you can change all of them later in Chikku settings.
Choose how many apps fit on a page and how big icons are.
3 × 4 grid, biggest icons and labels, easiest to see and tap
How should the list of all apps scroll?
Scroll up and down through all apps
Dark folders, drawer, search and menus.
Chikku only works as your home screen once Android uses it as the default home app. You can switch back at any time.
Chikku is your default home app.
Coming from another phone? Restore your Chikku layout and settings from a backup file.
Your layout and settings are back. Widgets need to be added again; tap each placeholder on the home screen.
Long-press the home screen for widgets and settings. Open Chikku settings from the app list for everything else, including backups.
Experimental. May change, disappear or not work on every device.
Grid, page and frame-timing numbers; never app names
To show it again, tap the version number in About 7 times
grid %1$d×%2$d · dock %3$d · pages %4$d · items %5$d\n%6$d×%7$d dp · %8$.2fx · frame %9$.1f ms · slow %10$d
You can also change it yourself: Settings > Apps > Default apps > Home app. The exact names can differ by phone maker.
